## Core Rule

## Decision Vocabulary
- AAA: Agent Asset Assessment
- ASA: Agent Selects Asset
- 200: policy requirements satisfied / OK to perform the authorized action
- 200 is not an investment rating, credit rating, or guarantee of safety.
